Every cheer family needs one person who shows up, sits down, and eats the snacks. This shirt is for that sibling, worn proudly at every meet and competition.

No glitter, no pink, just a clean unisex tee with deadpan humor that actually fits how bored (but loyal) siblings really feel. A perfect low-key gift from a cheer sister or brother.

Comfy, simple, and easy to wear on repeat all season long. Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
